manifest.name: sequence
manifest.description: One follow-up sequence of one space (BO-F3-03): an ordered list of day+channel steps with AI-personalized templates, a trigger that enrolls people, and an automatic stop at the first recorded reply. Every field is managed: a sequence exists only through the sequences package's create operation and moves draft -> active | paused only through its pause/resume operations. (backlog:22bb154a72ea)

migrations.name: create_sequences
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sequences (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  space_id TEXT,
  name TEXT,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('draft', 'active', 'paused')),
  decided_at TEXT,
  actor_type TEXT CHECK(actor_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  source_package TEXT,
  source_action TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sequences_space_id ON sequences(space_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sequences_status ON sequences(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sequences_source_package ON sequences(source_package);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_sequences
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."sequences" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "name" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('draft', 'active', 'paused')),
  "decided_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "actor_type" TEXT CHECK("actor_type" IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  "actor_id" TEXT,
  "source_package" TEXT,
  "source_action" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "sequences_space_id"
  ON "accordo"."sequences"("space_id");

CREATE INDEX "sequences_status"
  ON "accordo"."sequences"("status");

CREATE INDEX "sequences_source_package"
  ON "accordo"."sequences"("source_package");
